tips.text: Sweep the Hex Treasures on every Höllvania mission instead of grinding bounties; each map holds 8,500 standing of them.
Sweep with a squad; every treasure one person picks up counts for all four.
Bring Loot Detector or Thief's Wit with a Golden Instinct Helminth infusion, or Parallax's Orokin Eye, to tag the treasures.
Stop and listen when one treasure is missing; they glow green and make a sound you hear from close by.
Buy every KIM gift the moment you can afford it; the 20-point gifts cover most of the chemistry.
Keep one of each 750 treasure back; Rank 3 and Rank 5 each need a full set.
Pick KIM replies carefully; some end further conversation with that member and stall the Rank 4 chemistry.
Cap your standing every day from the start and run the chemistry in parallel, since Rank 4 chemistry is a daily countdown.
Spend your one free Rank 5 vendor item on the 15,000 standing main blueprint.
Ask a Rank 5 friend for built Blade and Hilt parts; they trade, though you still need Rank 5 for the main blueprint.
Players call Höllvania one of the least grindy syndicates; the daily cap and KIM pacing are the only walls.
Expect about 12 capped days at MR 14 if you hit the cap every day.
